description: Registry of upstream projects used as references, dependencies, or adaptation sources by Chess Atlas.

policy.principle: Reference first, adapt selectively, preserve provenance.
notes: An entry in this registry does not imply that upstream code has been copied into Chess Atlas.
Upstream licences must be checked before code, data, or assets are incorporated.
Record the upstream commit or release whenever Atlas begins depending on a specific implementation.
Keep Atlas modifications distinguishable from upstream source material.

upstreams.name: Infinite Chess
upstreams.role: Reference implementation for unbounded chess boards, navigation, rendering, and infinite-board interaction.

upstreams.name: 5D Chess Designer
upstreams.role: Reference implementation for branching timelines, multidimensional chess state, and 5D chess representation.

upstreams.name: Karpathy LLM Council
upstreams.role: Reference architecture for independent model responses, peer comparison, and chairman synthesis.

upstreams.name: Galaxy of Nuclides
upstreams.role: Reference implementation for interactive transitions between the periodic table, elements, isotopes, and the chart of nuclides.
upstreams.license: CC BY 4.0 - VERIFY CURRENT REPOSITORY LICENCE

upstreams.name: WorldDynamics.jl
upstreams.role: Julia framework for integrated assessment and world-system dynamics, providing an executable quantitative modelling reference for the Atlas.
